title: Control-panel Git view shows only the project root (main checkout), not the selected session's worktree or the project's other worktrees
outcome: From the control panel, Greg can see the Git state of every worktree of the project: the main checkout and the session worktrees (.tmp/wt-*, .worktrees/*, target/*). At minimum, the selected session's own worktree is shown, and he can choose among the project's worktrees as Git reports them (`git worktree list`). The state is read with Git on demand, without recursive file watching.
acceptance: With a project selected, the control panel's Git view shows the selected session's own worktree when the session works in one, or offers a clear choice of it, instead of always showing the project root.
The control panel lists the project's worktrees from `git worktree list` (branch or detached HEAD, path) and shows any one's status on selection, read on demand.
UI tests cover a session in a non-root worktree, and the project root, under a selected project. `cd ui && npx tsc --noEmit` and `npx vitest run` stay green.
